title: Ready, Steady, Transform! Digital+Culture: Work in Progress?
content:
The world of cultural work is changing. The question is: are we driving the change, or is it driving us? Join us for our annual forum in Budapest: 

  • Dates: 3, 4 and 5 December 2026.
  • Venue: Institut Français of Hungary, Budapest.
  • Registration: https://framaforms.org/registration-ready-steady-transform-1790756981
  • Provisional agenda: MCA Forum
  • Participation is 100% in presence and free of charge.

    • As a cross-sectoral and cross domain European network, we observe how digital technologies are reshaping every corner of our sector and in particular our working journey as professionals :  the way we create, preserve and share heritage; the way we engage communities; the way we train, collaborate, advocate, etc. Some of us are adapting, learning new tools, rethinking workflows, exploring new formats. Some of us are questioning what this means for our missions, our values, our relationship with the people we serve. Most of us are doing both at once.
